# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch55-56 (units.json only; gloss.json ignored)

Checks run: `t` joined equals the packet Geʿez (identical, 2582 signs, whitespace aside; verified before and after); ፨ rows
(8 on unit 16, 5 on unit 28) match the packet; `p` flags (units 0, 1, 17, 18) match the packet's paragraph and chapter
breaks; every unit ends at ። ፤ or ፨; unit 10 (49 words) has no inner ፤ to cut at, so it stays whole. Edits were made by
script; `t` and `p` are untouched. Units are numbered from 0.

Totals: major 2, moderate 8, minor 26 (findings, not edits; a finding that touches several units is counted once).

## Major
- **u23 · l, i, n** · `ተደፍነ` is the 3rd masculine singular perfect ("was covered"); a 1st plural would be ተደፈንነ. The draft parsed it as
  "we were covered" and offered that reading as its first choice, and the `i` had "minds ... have been covered". Done: l "and-was-covered our-mind";
  i "our mind has been covered over"; note rewritten (ኅሊናነ is the subject). The "cf. ch. 54" for ረስዐ was also dropped (ch. 54 does not have it).
- **u18 · l, i, n** · `ጐንዲያ` was glossed "sideways, aslant (?)". Ch. 30 already analyses it as the feminine converb of ጐንደየ "linger, delay",
  and that fits here: ዐረበት is feminine, and the sun "set, having lingered". Done: l "and-having-lingered (?) set"; i "then, having lingered (?), it set";
  note aligned with ch. 30. The same note also said ወአብርሃ is feminine; it is masculine (like ወረደ) and the feminine verbs are ዐረበት, ወአብርሀት, ወኢገብአት (fixed, minor).

## Moderate
- **u4, u17 · l, i, n** · ሞጻ / ሞፃ left as "mōṣā (?)". Published ch. 51–52 render ሞጻ "hem, fringe (?)" (and, with the garment, it is what Zadok brings),
  and that fits the heading of ch. 56 ("his giving"). Done: "her fringe (?)" in u4, "his giving of the fringe (?)" in u17; notes cite ch. 51–52. Also u17: `i` had
  an "and" with no ወ in the source (removed); ውሂቦ carries the suffix ዎ so it is no construct and "-of" was dropped from `l`.
- **u4, 5, 7, 11, 14, 15 · l, i, n (and `about`)** · ሰረገላ "chariot" against the house "cart" (ch. 30, 49–53, where the vehicle carries the Ark; the
  known-forms entry says so). Done: "cart(s)" everywhere in this part; u4 note says why.
- **u10 · i** · `ከማሁ በገንሕ ትደምፅ` ("so, in ገንሕ (?), it resounds") was dropped from the English (the similes were run together). Done: "and, like the voice of a lion that roars, so it
  resounded, loudly (?); and, like the thunder ... so it thundered".
- **u11, u12 · l, i, n** · ተላህያ was read as a verb ("the sea was enchanted"), but ለባሕር is a dative, and in u12 the adjectives ግሩም, መድምም, ዐዚዝ, ዕፁብ would then have no
  subject (they were made to describe the sea against the grammar). Done: ተላህያ taken as a noun, "delight (?)", still flagged uncertain: "there was delight (?) for the sea" /
  "Awesome beyond measure and astounding was the delight (?) for the sea". The second pass should check that the glosser does not state a verb.
- **u12 · l, n** · `l` had "not-ወኢያስተርእዩ (?)" (ወ doubled; the source is ወእለ ኢያስተርእዩ), and the note blamed a ወ before ኢያስተርእዩ. Done: "not-ያስተርእዩ (?)"; note corrected.
- **u13 · i** · እንዘ ("while") was lost, making the angels' praise a main clause; ደቂቀ መሬታዊያን (construct) became "earthly children". Done: "while the angels praised, the spiritual ones
  joined their praise with the sons of the earthly".
- **u25 · l, n** · `ኢጠየቀኑ` is formally 3rd masculine singular (2nd person would be ኢጠየቅከኑ); the draft rendered "did-you-not" without comment. Done: l "did-he(?)-not-examine", note says the sense needs "you",
  so the form may be slipped (?); `i` keeps "you".
- **u28 · i, n** · "Azaryas" in `i`; the house English is "Azariah" (ch. 43, 45). The note's "who is Azaryas?" is answered by ch. 43/45 (Zadok's son, who had boards made for Zion). Done. Also
  "boards (?) of wood" (ለውሕ is uncertain and the English had no hedge).

## Minor
- u1 · i · "in shouting (?)" → "in ውውዓ (?)", as ch. 38 leaves it.
- u1 · n · feminine ተሀውከት/ደምፀት beside masculine ፈለግ: added that they agree with feminine ግብጽ (?).
- u2 · i · "golden and silver eagles" → "images of eagles, of gold and silver" (አምሳለ was dropped).
- u3 · n · "first mention of the sun image": ch. 54 already has it; reworded.
- u4 · l, i · cloth words given (?) (ሜላተ is obscure in ch. 29, 46–48 and the known-forms entry); "wrapped" → "draped (?)" for the uncertain ፀፊሮሙ.
- u4 · n · ሜላተ note aligned with the published entry; ሞጻሃ's suffix ሃ named.
- u5 · n · lemma ገሠ → ጌሠ.
- u8 · n · added ኢተውህበት (T-passive, 3fs; subject ታቦተ in -ä form) and that ch. 17–20 also reads አረፍት "wall (?)".
- u10 · n · ተዐዱ marked as an odd form (as in ch. 17–20); ተቀበለቶሙ is "she received them" (ተቀበለት + ሙ), not "ተቀበለ + ቶሙ".
- u13 · n · typo ወፅኡ → ወወፅኡ.
- u14 · l · ብሔረምድያም left in Geʿez → "to-land-of-Midian". u14 · i, n · ጸዐኑ "loaded (?)" ("mounted" possible).
- u17 · n · ግብአተ labelled "construct (accusative)" → "construct".
- u18 · l, i · ውስተ is "in", not "at". u18 · n · "88 words" → 44.
- u19 · n · "the sun is Christ" stated as fact; now "a traditional reading, as at ch. 30; the passage only says 'sun'".
- u24 · l · "likeness-of-her" → "her-likeness" (a suffix, not a construct); n · false "cf. ch. 54" removed.
- u25 · i · "[the ተውንያ (?) of ዘቃማ (?)]" invented "the ... of"; now "[ተውንያ (?) ዘቃማ (?)]"; n notes ቃማ in ch. 51–52.
- u26 · i · "No, my lord" → "No, O lord" (እግዚኦ is the vocative, እግዚእየ is "my lord"); "three garments (?), that is, the one upon her" (the draft's own note calls the sense loose).
- `about` · "chariot" → "cart"; "bows and shelters her" → "bows to her while its creatures and birds honour her".

## Findings refused / left
- u2 ማኅፈደ "tower (?)": matches the known entry, and "tower of David" in ch. 36 supports it; not changed.
- ዕንዚራ "harps": ch. 38 left the word untranslated (?). I believe "harp" is right (the word is used in the Psalms), so left; noted for the editor.
- u6 ያስተፉንውዎሙ (?) "escorted": plural subject + ዎሙ fits; the sense stays hedged. u7 "beside the chariot" for በሰረገላ: the note already hedges "alongside"; left.
- u8 ጠግዐ "stood firm (?)" and the God-as-subject of ወአኅለፎሙ: both hedged or reasonable; left. u10 ኀብረ as verb (not noun): reasonable; left.
- u19 ተሀየይዎ "set itself against it (?)": the hedge is present and the context (they wished to cover its light) supports hostility; left. "after it ... in him" mixes it/him as the source does (ሁ/ቦቱ).
- u22 "Woe to us and to our children": the draft's note explains the apposition; left. u5 "lifted up the measure of a cubit": clumsy but faithful; left.
- u18 tense of አመ ትመጽእ: past in the dream's frame, as the note says; left. u15 ደወለ "border (?)" and ነፉስ "wind": match the known entries.
- Nothing in `t`, `p` or the ፨ rows was changed.

# Review, pass 2 — kebra-nagast-ch55-56 (gloss.json against the revised units.json; units.json re-read)

Checks run: every gloss.json entry (175 keys, plus `__broaden__`) read against every unit where its form occurs; every known-forms entry
read against this part's use (a new use gets a `__broaden__` line); lemmas checked against the published parts' glossaries (ch. 2–54);
`t` joined equals the packet (2582 signs, identical, before and after); ፨ rows (8 on unit 16, 5 on unit 28) and `p` flags (units 0, 1, 17, 18) unchanged.
Edits by script; Geʿez keys untouched. Dillmann was not available: lemma and sense claims I could not confirm are hedged (?).

Totals: major 1, moderate 13, minor 33 (a finding touching several entries is counted once).

## Major
- **ወተደፍነ · gloss** · still the pre-pass-1 reading "we were covered / it was covered, 1cp or 3ms, ambiguous", against units.json (3ms, subject ኅሊናነ).
  Done: lemma ተደፈነ, "and it was covered (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ደፈነ; subject ኅሊናነ; a 1cp perfect would be ተደፈንነ)".

## Moderate
- **ተላህያ · gloss** · "unparsed; perhaps a verb 'was enchanted'" contradicted pass 1 (noun, dative ለባሕር). Done: "delight (?) (noun, unparsed form ... not a verb)"; no verb is stated anywhere.
- **ወጐንዲያ · gloss** · "unidentified, perhaps 'aslant'" contradicted pass 1 and ch. 30. Done: ጐንደየ, "having lingered (?) (gerund, 3fs, as ጐንዲያ in ch. 30)".
- **ሞጻሃ, ሞፃ · gloss** · "unidentified, perhaps 'offering'" against the published ch. 51–52 "fringe (?)" and the revised units. Done: "her fringe (?)" / "fringe (?)", lemma ሞጻ for both.
- **ወተሀየይዎ · gloss + u19 n** · glossed "unparsed" though ch. 30 (ተሀየዮሙ) and ch. 54 (ተሀየየ) give the lemma ተሀየየ. Done: ተሀየየ, 3mp perfect + ዎ, sense hedged (?); the note of u19 cites ch. 30 and 54 instead of "I cannot parse it".
- **ኢጠየቀኑ · gloss** · "did you not examine ... read as 2ms" against pass 1 (form is 3ms; 'you' is the sense). Done: "did he not examine? ... the form may be slipped (?)".
- **ሰረገላ, ሰረገላቲሆሙ, በሰረገላ · `__broaden__`** · three broaden lines added "chariot" for this part, contradicting pass 1 ("cart" throughout) and the known entries, which already cover "cart". Done: the three lines removed.
- **ሰረገላትኒ · gloss** · "chariots also" → "carts also".
- **፫ · gloss/broaden** · no entry at all; the published entry says only "chapter number", wrong for "three cubits" (u11) and "three garments" (u26). Done: `__broaden__` line, old entry whole + " · also a counted number 'three' (...)"; the Geʿez for a feminine noun (ሠለስ) is hedged (?). ፶፭ and ፶፮ follow the published ፶፩–፶፬ format and number words; left.
- **ተረስዐ · gloss + u23 l, i, n** · "spoiled" given as fact, but ረስዐ is "forget" in ch. 9–12, 24, 31–32 (and 'ruin' in the causative, ch. 54). Done: entry hedged "spoiled, ruined or forgotten (?)"; `l` and `i` get (?), the note cites the published uses.
- **ወአዕረፉ · gloss** · "causative of ረፍ 'rest'": no such verb (invented). Done: አዕረፈ A stem, as ch. 42.
- **ዘእቀውም · `__broaden__`** · known entry "who stand (1cs)" does not give "as though I stood" (ከመ ዘእቀውም). Done: broaden line.
- **አርአያ · `__broaden__`** · known "image, likeness"; this part's `i` has "vision". Done: broaden line.
- **ወዕፁብ · `__broaden__`** · known "and hard, difficult"; this part has "wondrous". Done: broaden line.

## Minor
- ዐረበት · lemma ዐርበ (misspelled) → ዐረበ. ወኬዱ · lemma ኬደ → ከይደ (ch. 24, spelled ኬደ). ነጽሮታ, ነጽሮ · lemma was the verbal noun → ነጸረ (as ch. 28). በፅግም · lemma ፅግም → ፀጋም (ch. 51–52). ንዉምየ · lemma → ኖመ (ch. 30). ዘቃማ · lemma had the ዘ- → ቃማ (?), cross-referred to ch. 51–52.
- ይጠፍሑ · hedge dropped, cites ch. 53 (ወይጠፍሑ); u12 n "(ጠፍሐ, ?)" → "as in ch. 53". ኢያስተርእዩ · "those not appearing" put the እለ into the verb → "they do not appear (?)". ይድፍኑ · "they cover" → subjunctive after ፈቀዱ. ውውዓ · "noun or verb" → unidentified noun, as ch. 38–39. ነዋኃት · also አድባር ነዋኃት. ወአረፍት · "plural-like" dropped, cites ch. 17–20. ጸዐኑ · "loaded", mounted possible (?), cites ch. 51–52. አድያመ · (?) added, as ch. 31–32. በኀቤሃ · "from beside her". በአረፍተ · "sides (?), walls (?)". እንስሳሆሙ · "livestock, flocks" (published "beast, livestock"). ወጌሡ · lemma ጌሠ tidied. ነጺፎሙ, ወፀፊሮሙ (gloss) and u4, u18 notes · "converb" → "gerund", as in ch. 29–30.
- ዕንዚራተ, ወበዕንዚራት, ዕንዚራት · ch. 38–39 leave the word "perhaps a harp or lyre"; the entries now say "harp" is by convention and cite that. `i` keeps "harps" (pass 1's ruling; a hedge in every line would be noise).
- `__broaden__` lines added where this part's use is new: ባሕረ (object/goal), ኀቤሃ ('with'), ላቲ ('to her'), ኵሎሙ (before a noun), መጽሐፈ (construct), ለባሕር ('for'), እስራኤል (subject), ዘአስተርአየኒ ('who appeared'), ለጽዮን (owner after a suffix), አልቦ ('no'), ኀዋኅወ ('doors, gates (?)'; the known lemma ኀውኅ is 'window'), ተዐዱ (perhaps ተዐደወ, hedged). Each keeps the old entry whole + " · " + the new reading (checked by script).

## Findings refused / left
- እሊአሃ "her ones (?)": the lemma and sense cannot be checked without Dillmann; hedged already; left. መዋግዲሃ / መዋግድ ሞግድ and ታንፈርዕጽ, ይትበተኩ, ዘይጥሕር, በገንሕ: all hedged (?), no published parallel; left.
- ፶፭ ፶፮ number words (ኀምሳ ወኀምስቱ, ኀምሳ ወስድስቱ): same pattern and spelling as ፶፩–፶፬ in the published parts; not re-hedged.
- ወአኅለፎሙ, ተሠጥቀት (ሠጠቀ is "draw out" in ch. 51–52; 'split' is the sense of the context): left, as pass 1.
- u10 ተዐዱ "when Zion crossed" with a plural verb: noted already; only the lemma hint added.
- No change to `t`, `p` or the ፨ rows. Nothing else in units.json needed changing beyond the notes above.
